checked_decisions.finding: Per task instructions, dialogue_13747 ('滅.' -> 'Perish.') is explicitly allowed to exceed its 2-character budget because the source is a single dense character with no viable ASCII rendering that short; left unchanged and unflagged as an error.
'What' (no punctuation) is the tightest viable rendering of '何！？' inside its 4-character budget; not a meaning error, just an unavoidable loss of emphasis.
Unnamed referents (an unidentified fighter; enemy pilots) correctly kept gender-neutral, matching BASE_RULES on not inferring gender for unidentified parties.

'Ichijyo' correctly uses the locked full-name spelling from character_names_021.json even though it contains a lowercase j; locked names are exempt from the j/q avoidance guidance, consistent with BASE_RULES precedence for locked spellings.

'周りを固めろ！' (hold/tighten the perimeter) rendered as 'Cover us!' is a looser tactical paraphrase but not a reversal; both are defensive-formation commands to allies at the start of combat, and the 12-character budget leaves little room for a more literal rendering. Left as is.
